0x00081E.en: 「At my level now...@　this is as far as I go...!」

0x00088F.en: 「Kh!@　So this is where it ends...!!」

0x000917.en: 「Dammit!@　Next time you won't get me!」

0x000A40.en: 「Is this as far as I go...!?」

0x000A78.en: 「Oh dear...@　how uncool of me, geez!」

0x000B7C.en: 「No way I screw up here...!@　This isn't fun...」

0x000BD0.en: 「I blew it...!@　No choice but to bail...」

0x000CBA.en: 「This is as far as I go...!」

0x000D21.en: 「This is the end for me... I leave the rest to you.」

0x000D53.en: 「Dammit...!@　Is this as far as I get!」

0x000D8F.en: 「Nngh! Got the worst of it, did I...」

0x000DCD.en: 「No good, I took too many hits... Retreating!」

0x000E1A.en: 「Well, this is a mess. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000E58.en: 「Kyaah, I leave the rest to you!」

0x000E9F.en: 「To think the Granzon... would be shot down...」

0x000F4A.en: 「Kh... So I become a shooting star after all... Ejecting!」

0x001001.en: 「Owowow... I give. A miscalculation on my part.」

0x001086.en: 「U... ngh! So this is where it ends...!」

0x00113A.en: 「I'm sorry. The rest is up to you.」

0x00116F.en: 「Damn it! Is this as far as I go...!」

0x0011B3.en: 「I can't fight any longer! Falling back!」

0x00122C.en: 「Ngh... you're as good as they say.」

0x00125B.en: 「To be taken down in a place like this...@ I've still got so much to learn...!」

0x0012A9.en: 「No good, I can't take any more! Falling back!」

0x001393.en: 「N-no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x0013D1.en: 「Well, well, so this is the end.」

0x001400.en: 「I can't go on any further. Please excuse me.」

0x00148B.en: 「Was I careless...@ I'll pull back for now...!」

0x0015F1.en: 「Retreating...@ ngh...! So much for looking cool...」

0x0016AF.en: 「Grraah! Not in a place like this!!」

0x00181E.en: 「So I've still got room to grow...!」

0x0018F3.en: 「Looks like I've got no choice but to fall back...!」

0x001951.en: Holy Langran Kingdom, Ruzak Province, Ramond City

0x001991.en: 「Current location... about 30 kilometers south@ of Ramond City in Ruzak Province, I'd say.」

0x0019FA.en: 「Which means... we really did@ make it back to <La Gias>, meow.」

0x001A67.en: 「Yeah, that was the plan all along.」

0x001AA5.en: 「But there's nobody else here besides us, meow...@ What about Kyosuke and Ryusei...?」

0x001B19.en: 「If we ended up here...@ maybe they made it back to the surface too?」

0x001BA6.en: 「Still, a whole lot sure happened, meow.」

0x001BF3.en: 「Well, it was rough, but it worked out.@ Aside from Kyosuke and Ryusei, telling the others@ would just make things complicated...」

0x001CCB.en: 「Let's keep it to ourselves for now.」

0x001D0C.en: 「Now then, glad we're back in <La Gias>, but...」

0x001D54.en: 「We should dig up some information somewhere, meow.」

0x001D8E.en: 「...Then let's start by squeezing@ it out of those guys.」

0x001DE4.en: 「Huh? Ah, heat source at 10 o'clock! It's close, meow!」

0x001E70.en: 「There are few spirits around here.@ Even Cybuster's spirit radar has its limits.」

0x001EEA.en: 「From this reading, it's not the Kirkus army.@ The energy signature's way too small, meow.」

0x001F5E.en: 「Yeah, this raw bloodlust in the air...@ they're bandits, if I had to guess.」

0x001FDC.en: 「Nah, all those guys think about is making money.@ 'Bandits' is the right word. Let's go, Kuro, Shiro!」

0x002082.en: 「B-boss! That there's a <Masou Kishin>!!@ I saw one back when I was in the army!」

0x002133.en: 「Gah! L-let's run, boss!@ We don't stand a chance!!」

0x002195.en: 「Hold it! This is a golden opportunity!@ If we get our hands on a Masou Kishin,@ old Gold's rep will skyrocket!」

0x002234.en: 「And Gadeck's crew won't be able to@ lord it over us anymore! Fight like your lives depend on it!@ Nab that thing and we'll be rich!」

0x0022FA.en: 「...They really think they can beat@ Cybuster with that, meow.」

0x002353.en: 「Bandits are all the same.@ They leap at the bait in front of them without@ measuring their own strength. Textbook stuff.」

0x002417.en: 「The goal is gathering intel, but...@ guys like that won't answer straight.@ I'll rough 'em up and wring it out of 'em.」

0x0024F4.en: 「Hey, bandits!@ Surrender quietly, or become food for the dead right here!@ Two choices! Now hurry up and pick!!」

0x00259F.en: 「Nnh!? Wh-what is that intensity!?@ I-is that the Masou Kishin...!!」

0x002607.en: 「Meow? That worked better than I expected, meow.」

0x002669.en: 「Bah, like I'd back down with treasure right there!@ Masou Kishin or not, four of us hitting it at once@ can manage somehow!」

0x002705.en: 「Smash the cockpit and it's just@ a big hunk of scrap!」

0x00275B.en: 「Then come and get it! I'll take you down easy!」

0x002798.en: 「A-a Masou Kishin...! I-is it a monster!!」

0x00284C.en: 「I-if it's come to this... Teacher, please!」

0x0028C4.en: 「Don't tell me they've got a hired gun!?」

0x0028F5.en: 「Yes yes~!@ You called and I came flying, la la la la la~n!」

0x00295B.en: 「I owe these folks for a meal and a bed.@ Well, it was only yesterday, though.」

0x0029CF.en: 「Weigh duty against compassion,@ and duty wins out... that kind of deal?」

0x002A81.en: 「Whoa whoa, look closer, isn't that Cybuster?@ Then the one riding it is...」

0x002B14.en: 「Wh-why is Excellen@ in a place like this, meow...!?」

0x002B64.en: 「Wh-what in the world is going on, meow...!?」

0x002BA4.en: 「That's... exactly what I'd like to ask.」

0x002BEA.en: 「You're the ringleader, right? I've got questions for you.」

0x002C4C.en: 「Ho, still got that much mouth on you?@ That smart mouth of yours... is it this one!?」

0x002CB7.en: 「Ow!! I' hurhs! I' hurhs!!@ I-I won't dawk! I'll dawk, I'll dawk! I said I'll dawk!!」

0x002D9F.en: 「That hired gun, where'd you pick her up?」

0x002DCD.en: 「Pick up's not quite it... more like@ we had a real bad time of it...」

0x002E20.en: 「My my, that's a nasty way to put it.@ Just who was it that suddenly attacked@ a poor, defenseless maiden?」

0x002EC3.en: 「...The bandits tried to steal her machine@ and got beaten at their own game.」

0x002F19.en: 「So how'd that turn her into your hired gun?」

0x002F5C.en: 「Well, one thing led to another, and it helps with intel too.@ I got dragged into <La Gias> out of nowhere@ and was in a bind.」

0x003028.en: 「Yeah.@ I'd heard about La Gias from Martha before,@ and these bandit fellows explained it too, but...」

0x0030C1.en: 「I probably wasn't the only one who came to this world.@ Maybe everyone from the Steel Dragon Squadron@ who was running exercises with me is here too...」

0x0031E7.en: 「Tell me about La Gias these past few days...@ what each faction's been up to, especially the@ Kirkus army and the Shutedonias army.」

0x003295.en: 「What about the Feil-Lord army? That all right?」

0x0032DE.en: 「What!? The Feil-Lord army!?@ Prince Feil is alive!?」

0x003343.en: 「Huh? You didn't know?@ Word is Prince Feil-Lord is fighting the Shutedonias@ on Leg Island in Saitzet Province right now.」

0x003483.en: 「Oh my, did his whole character just change?」

0x0034D6.en: 「I am called Gold Bagold.@ A bandit though I may be now, I once served@ as a garrison commander in the Shutedonias army.」

0x0035C4.en: 「Yes.@ But my wife was of Langran birth.」

0x003617.en: 「Because of that, the internal affairs division framed me@ in an inspection... and I deserted the army.」

0x003673.en: 「And then... word reached me that my wife had died of illness,@ and in my despair I turned to banditry...」

0x0036F1.en: 「But seeing the way you fought@ has opened my eyes. I beg of you.@ Won't you take me along with you?」

0x0037A2.en: 「...Just so you know, I'm fresh out of dumplings.」

0x0037E9.en: 「No, never mind.@ Bottom line, you want revenge@ on Shutedonias...」

0x003864.en: 「Well, the motive's a bit weak, but fine.@ Tag along.」

0x0038B4.en: 「Th-thank you.@ I'll be sure to make myself useful.」

0x003907.en: 「All right, first let's get you some food...」

0x003938.en: 「Masaki, a reading on the spirit radar!@ An energy signature and a spatial distortion!」

0x0039BC.en: 「A Gate...!@ Has someone from the surface been summoned...!?」

0x003A09.en: 「Ah!@ Three <Masou Ki> are closing in on us, meow!」

0x003A92.en: 「Is that Lord Randall in the Cybuster?@ I am Lieutenant Zetiquinez of the Ruzak Militia border patrol.@ Can you hear me?」

0x003B4C.en: 「Yeah.@ Looks like Shutedonias hasn't gotten@ its hands on Ruzak yet.」

0x003BB5.en: 「So it was you, Lord Randall.@ Are you here to investigate the Gate, perhaps?」

0x003C29.en: 「I just happened to be in the area.@ And the name's Masaki. I threw away@ the Randall name.」

0x003CDB.en: 「...Hey, hey, Martha.@　On the surface you're just a lost little kitten,@　but down here you're actually a big shot?」

0x003D71.en: 「Who're you calling a lost little puppy!」

0x003DAC.en: 「Tch... Anyway, any idea what@　caused the Gate to open?」

0x003E05.en: 「They've been looking into it for a while now,@　but we honestly can't say...」

0x003E67.en: 「For a while? This has happened before?」

0x003EAD.en: 「Oh my, you hadn't heard?@　Lately we've had no end of trouble with Gates@　opening for no known reason.」

0x003F58.en: 「Any number of surface-dwellers@　have already been summoned to this land.」

0x003FD6.en: 「The spirit radar's picking something up!@　But it's not a Machine Beast, meow! It's almost on us!」

0x004087.en: 「The spirit-wave interference is too strong.@　Ever since the <Barrier of Harmony> broke,@　the spirits' power has been unstable.」

0x004186.en: 「I should have mentioned it sooner, but@　summoned surface-dwellers often pilot@　those Machine Beast knock-offs.」

0x004216.en: 「But that thing... it's not a Federation unit.」

0x004298.en: 「The Shutedonias army hires types like that@　as mercenaries.」

0x0042FA.en: 「Tch...! I'll deal with them!@　Torres, you pull back!」

0x004368.en: 「No, we'll help you as well, Lord Masaki.」

0x004436.en: 「Hm? Is he looking at little Weiss?」

0x004476.en: 「An <Einst>! So it came to this land too!」

0x0044CE.en: 「You're going to feel the pain of this wound too!」

0x00450E.en: 「What's with this guy...!?@　Is he mistaking the Rein Weissritter@　for an Einst!?」

0x004592.en: 「Well, it does look kind of Einst-ish.」

0x0045D8.en: 「You tangled with that guy before or something?」

0x00461B.en: 「Nope, I think this is our first meeting...@　Maybe he's got a grudge against the real Einst@　and he's taking it out on us.」

0x0046AE.en: 「I'll take down the Einst! Commence attack!」

0x0046FE.en: 「Ngh, no more of this! Falling back!」

0x004732.en: 「Curse you, Einst...!@ I'll settle my grudge from Langley, no matter what!」

0x004831.en: 「Isn't that a surface-dweller@　who came through that Gate?」

0x004881.en: 「If so, we can't just leave them, huh.」

0x004914.en: 「...What's with this one?@　Sleeping like a baby.」

0x004967.en: 「Lord Masaki, let's rest at our base for now.」

0x0049D2.en: 「Get my hands on a Machine God,@　and yesterday's disgrace is wiped clean!」

0x004A25.en: 「The hell are you babbling about!@　Don't think you can beat the Cybuster!」

0x004AE9.en: 「Whoever we belong to doesn't matter!@　You're our enemy all the same!」

0x004B82.en: 「The source is already long gone, though...@　Guess there's no point telling him.」

0x004BED.en: 「So long as that unit and you exist,@　the Einst are not truly destroyed!」

0x004C52.en: （About little Alfimi...@　better not to bring her up, huh.）

0x004D23.en: 「Oh, you're awake. Well,@　'came to' is more like it.」

0x004D79.en: 「...Huh? Kyaaah!! Wh-what, what is this!@　Who are you!? Why are you in my room!?」

0x004E05.en: 「Whoa!? H-hey, calm down!@　Look around, is this your room!?@　Ow ow! Quit scratching!」

0x004E9E.en: 「Wow, a cat-claw attack that'd@　make Kuro and Shiro turn pale.」

0x004EFD.en: 「Wh-who are you people!? Dragging me off@　to a place like this, what do you want!?」

0x004F74.en: 「I'm telling you, my family's poor!@　Kidnap me and you won't get any money!」

0x004FEE.en: 「Look here...@　Do you seriously not remember a thing?」

0x005087.en: 「Pipe down!@　Shut up and listen to me! Got it!!」

0x0050F6.en: 「Listen, I'm no kidnapper.@　This is La Gias... put simply, a world@　inside a hollow within the Earth.」

0x00518F.en: 「And for some reason, you were summoned here.」

0x0051CC.en: 「We'd collapsed... no, we were just asleep.@　We found you and took you in like this,@　to keep you safe. Got it?」

0x0052A9.en: 「What exactly are you after?@　...Oh, I get it! You were dazzled by@　my good looks and kidnapped me!」

0x005351.en: 「And you're planning to marry me, right!@　You're kind of a looker, but I hate pushy guys!@　No way I'm getting swept into a shotgun wedding!」

0x00540E.en: 「No, no, Martha doesn't have it in him.」

0x005546.en: 「...Sorry, thanks.@　I'm no good with this type...@　She reminds me of Lune.」

0x0055C1.en: 「If that girl heard that, there'd be hell to pay.」

0x005629.en: 「Well, she might let a fist or two fly.」

0x005694.en: 「...Shut it.@　Anyway, let's get our information straight...」
